amendment_rationale: Runtime window constraint: the v1 budget implies ~264 MC-DE runs per execute (4 searches x (8 candidates + 3 validation seeds) x ~6 probes) at N=2000, ~180-270 s per run at q=1024 -> ~15 h execute, ~30 h with strict replay. The amendment keeps every scientific parameter, seed, candidate, gate, and validation semantics identical and only changes execution budgets and the probe protocol (screen-then-search).

unchanged_from_v1.rho_rule: harmonic-exact concentrated two-point from (1-R): target=(1-R)*sum lambda_i/i, w_lo=(target-1/d_hi)/(1/d_lo-1/d_hi), integer dc degenerates to regular; reconstructed rate error <= 1e-12
unchanged_from_v1.mcde_semantics: full length-q probability vectors, batched WHT check convolution, exact sampled edge-view degrees, fresh channel term, floor 1e-300, fail-closed normalization, base-q mean entropy convergence, seeded PCG64 determinism

gates.robust_failure: STOP before any codebook; immutable evidence

unchanged_from_v1.selection_rule: winner = max threshold proxy among searched eligible candidates (ties C1..C8 canonical order)
unchanged_from_v1.validation_rule: winner re-evaluated on the 3 validation seeds (same probe range and p_tol); conservative threshold = min over seeds of per-seed threshold proxy
unchanged_from_v1.resource_policy: ctypes process-tree RSS watcher, 3 GiB cap, aborted_resource_limit on breach
unchanged_from_v1.rank_policy: rank(H)=m for every finite matrix; <=5 bounded relabel attempts then blocker
unchanged_from_v1.leakage_policy: L_recon=10*m, fixed 64-bit tag, L_total=10*m+64, hard caps; no other payload; Toeplitz public_control n*10+63
unchanged_from_v1.immutability: plan frozen before any result; a failed execute is immutable and never tuned/rerun

amended_budget_v2.screen_protocol: per search, each candidate C1..C8 runs ONE full-budget run_mcde at p = gate (its search gate); converged => eligible (record '>= gate'); not converged => ineligible, recorded '< gate', NO binary search (an ineligible candidate cannot win because any eligible candidate's proxy is >= gate > its threshold)
amended_budget_v2.eligible_search: binary search over [gate, p_hi] for eligible candidates in canonical order, capped at the FIRST 4 eligible (further eligible recorded '>= gate', not searched); winner = max proxy among searched
amended_budget_v2.no_eligible: if no candidate is eligible => the search gate FAILS (frozen), recorded as '< gate' with the screen evidence
amended_budget_v2.validation: winner on the 3 validation seeds, full binary search over the same probe range with p_tol=0.002 (unchanged from v1); conservative = min per-seed proxy
amended_budget_v2.implementation_optimization: batch-draw gathers (one rng.integers call per update phase, single fancy-index gather over the (max_draws, N, q) axis) to cut per-iteration gather overhead; determinism is per this frozen v2 protocol; the v1-protocol interrupted trial (n_samples=2000) is NOT byte-comparable and is excluded from any comparison
amended_budget_v2.expected_run_count_per_search: 8 screens + up to 4x6 eligible probes + 18 validation runs <= 50 runs (typical 35-42); expected execute total ~4-5.5 h, strict replay identical
amended_budget_v2.run_count_cap: hard cap 60 runs per search; exceeding it is a blocker, not a tuning path

stop_rules: unchanged: robust gate failure stops V9 before codebooks; target failure selects robust with efficiency_target_not_met; a failed execute is immutable and never tuned/rerun; the execute must be run exactly once and strict-replayed exactly once with byte-identical outputs
